title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Microsoft Graph APIs for agent and app inventory and details
summary: The briefing passes: the inventory calls, blocking paths, licence requirement and roadmap facts are supported. Add citations for the stand-alone licensing option and the explanation of application permissions; neither issue changes the administrative guidance.

claims.claim: Blocking restricts use of the selected agent across the organisation, subject to the stated host qualification.

claims.claim: For agents created using SharePoint or Microsoft Foundry, blocking only affects Microsoft Copilot Chat availability.

claims.claim: Blocking applies to the selected agent and should not be assumed to apply to its entire plugin package.
claims.quote: These actions apply to the selected agent. If the agent is included in a plugin, don't assume the action also applies to the whole plugin package, its skills, shared MCP servers, or connections.
